source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("County and rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Ballymena rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. All the outgoing members were returned unopposed except at Clough and Glenbuck, where two new members were returned without a contest. Of Tullybane; in place of Mr. William Linton, who retired. Returned unopposed.
